categoryImageSync.A001_status: STABLE — POS category click activates correct pill across all 9 probed categories in both rounds; item count per category identical (Toutes=31, Sandwich Cayenne=5, Galette=2, Sandwich Classique=2, Burgers=2, Tacos=2, Bols=8, Frites=2, Boissons=8). No regression introduced by A-001 sort fix.

errorAsymmetry.analysis: 31 networkErrors all 401 Unauthorized. Ordered breakdown: (1) /api/admin/pos/counter-collect/pending — 401 ON POS-V4 PAGE during cashier flow (first signal). (2) /api/admin/oss-order — 401 ON POS-V4 PAGE. (3) /api/admin/default-access — 401 ON POS-V4 PAGE. (4) /api/admin/setting/branch — 401. (5-17) 13 /api/admin/dashboard/* — 401 cluster from auto-redirect to /login after first 401 triggered app.js axios interceptor router.push to auth.login. (18) /api/auth/logout — 401 (already logged out). (19-31) Second /api/admin/dashboard/* batch after page now at /login.
errorAsymmetry.rootCauseTheory: A single early 401 on /api/admin/pos/counter-collect/pending fired before all auth headers were fully attached to the SPA polling pipeline. The app.js global axios interceptor (resources/js/app.js:171-176) then dispatched logout + router.push(auth.login). Every subsequent in-flight or queued polling XHR landed on the now-defaulted /login page and 401-ed in turn. Result: 1 root 401 -> 30 cascade 401s.
errorAsymmetry.roundOneMaskingHypothesis: Round 1 surfaces[11].url = http://localhost:8000/admin/pos-v4 with logout.clicked=false — Round 1 ended its session WITHOUT triggering the /login redirect, so the cascade never happened. Round 2 surfaces[11].url = http://127.0.0.1:8000/login — Round 2 DID redirect (either via explicit logout button click OR via the cascade described above). The original Round 1 GO verdict was likely concealing this latent issue.
errorAsymmetry.severityAssessment: P2/P3 — does NOT block cashier journey (all 17 captures visually intact, encaisser modal opened successfully with X1 SSOT order list visible, D4 stock-rupture banner working, A-001 categories filtering correctly). The 401 cascade is a console/network noise issue on session-end, not a functional UX defect. Recommend separate P3 ticket: "POS V4 cashier session 401-cascade on first counter-collect polling failure — investigate token-attach race or revert app.js auto-redirect for /admin/pos-v4 surface to prevent dashboard widget cascade pollution.

analysisNote: AUTO-VERDICT HEAL retained from spec computation (consoleErrors=31 > 15 threshold + pageErrors=10 > 0). Round-1-vs-round-2 reconciliation: visual + functional cashier journey IDENTICAL across both rounds (17/17 captures parity, A-001 category-sort PASS, D4 cross-link PASS, X1 modal PASS). The R1->R2 verdict downgrade is driven by 31 401-cascade network errors that Round 1 did NOT observe because Round 1 never redirected to /login (logout.clicked=false). The cascade traces to a single root 401 on /api/admin/pos/counter-collect/pending which triggered the global axios interceptor (resources/js/app.js:171-176) to auto-logout + redirect, after which all queued dashboard polls landed on /login and 401-ed. Recommendation: file P3 ticket for this race/cascade. Cashier journey itself = GO. POS non-wizard surface = no functional regression from A-001/D1/D4 fix waves.
